name: How do I choose a contractor for a whole-home renovation?
description: Select a contractor based on experience, communication, licensing, insurance, and project portfolio. Compare detailed bids and check references.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a contractor involves evaluating their experience, communication style, and portfolio of similar projects. Look for contractors who are licensed, insured, and have a strong track record of completing projects on time and within budget. We recommend getting detailed bids from multiple contractors, checking references, and reviewing their approach to project management to ensure a good fit for your vision.
